name: document-qa-backend
description: Document Q&A: idempotent uploads with content-hash dedupe, a RabbitMQ pipeline (extract, chunk, embed, index) with leased per-stage jobs, pgvector retrieval with access enforced twice, versioned documents with an atomic switch, tombstone-first deletion with tracked purge, a validated answer cache and durable streamed answer runs

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,api2,workers,embed,model -c blue,blue,yellow,magenta,cyan "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:server1" "npm run dev:workers" "npm run dev:embedder" "npm run dev:model"
scripts.start: concurrently -n api,api2,workers,embed,model "tsx src/api/index.ts" "PORT=3001 tsx src/api/index.ts" "tsx src/worker/supervisor.ts" "tsx src/embedder/index.ts" "tsx src/model/index.ts"
